web-mobile-development.title: Web Development and Mobile App Development
web-mobile-development.short: Custom websites, web applications and iOS and Android apps built for performance and growth.
web-mobile-development.lead: Websites and apps that present your business clearly, work on every device and are easy to maintain.
intro: We design and build websites, web applications and mobile apps for businesses that need a dependable digital presence. Our work ranges from a corporate website to a customer portal or a mobile app.
Every project starts with your goals and users. We then choose a sensible architecture, build in small, testable steps and keep you informed throughout.
ch: An outdated or slow website
Ageing sites lose visitors and are hard to update or secure.
Poor mobile experience
Many customers browse on phones, and clumsy layouts cost enquiries.
Disconnected systems
Forms, CRMs and payment tools that do not talk to each other create manual work.
Unclear ownership after launch
Without maintenance, sites slow down, break or fall behind on security.
ap: We map goals, audiences, content and constraints.
We plan journeys and design responsive, accessible interfaces.
We build front end and back end in short, reviewable iterations.
We test performance, accessibility, security and devices.
We launch with monitoring, backups and a rollback plan.
We provide updates, fixes and ongoing improvements.
sol: Fast, secure sites built to your brand.
Clear structure for services, teams and enquiries.
Product catalogues, baskets and checkout integration.
Layouts that adapt from phone to desktop.
Mobile apps for customers or staff.
Connect CRMs, payment tools and other systems.
Faster load times and better Core Web Vitals.
Crawlable, inclusive pages built in from the start.
ben: A clearer, more credible online presence
A foundation that can grow with you
uc: UK professional-services firm
A new website with service pages and an enquiry form saved securely.
US online retailer
A faster storefront with checkout integration and clearer product pages.
Multi-site operator
A customer portal and mobile app for bookings and account updates.

cs.p: A fictional professional-services firm has an ageing site that is slow on phones and hard to update.
cs.s: A mobile-first website with clear service pages, an enquiry form saved to a database and a companion mobile app.
cs.o: Expected benefits (illustrative): easier navigation, clearer enquiry routes and simpler updates.

faq: Do you build both websites and mobile apps?
Yes, separately or together, depending on what your customers need.
Can you improve our existing website?
Usually. We review it first and recommend whether to improve it or rebuild parts of it.
How long does a project take?
It depends on scope. We agree a plan and milestones before work begins.
Will you maintain the site after launch?
Yes. Ongoing maintenance and improvement plans are available.
Do you handle accessibility and SEO?
We build with both in mind, but we do not guarantee search rankings.

ai-workflow-automation.title: Agentic AI, Workflow and Automation
ai-workflow-automation.short: AI assistants and automated workflows that reduce repetitive work, with people in control.
ai-workflow-automation.lead: Practical AI and automation that take on repetitive tasks and support your team, with clear limits and human oversight.
intro: We help businesses apply AI where it genuinely helps: answering routine questions, processing documents, moving data between systems and preparing work for human review.
We design each workflow with clear boundaries, approval steps and monitoring, so people stay in control and you can see what the system is doing.
ch: Repetitive manual tasks
Staff spend hours copying, checking and re-entering information.
Inconsistent processes
Work is handled differently depending on who does it.
Slow customer responses
Routine questions queue up behind complex ones.
Uncertainty about AI risk
Teams worry about accuracy, data handling and loss of control.
ap: Find processes where automation is genuinely useful.
Agree what the system may do and where people approve.
Plan data flow, integrations and escalation paths.
Develop and test on realistic cases, including edge cases.
Launch with logging, review steps and access controls.
Track quality, fix issues and refine over time.
sol: Assistants that answer questions and draft responses.
Agents that carry out defined, bounded tasks.
Automate multi-step processes end to end.
Remove copy, paste and re-entry work.
Connect the tools your team already uses.
Handle common questions and hand over complex ones.
Link systems through APIs and webhooks.
Logging, access control and quality checks.
ben: More consistent handling of routine tasks
Clear visibility of what the system does
uc: US services firm
Extracting key fields from incoming documents for staff review.
UK online retailer
A support assistant that answers common questions and hands over complex ones.
Operations team
Automated weekly reporting assembled from several systems.

cs.p: A fictional operations team spends hours reading documents and re-typing details into other systems.
cs.s: An AI-assisted workflow extracts key fields, checks rules and sends anything uncertain to a human reviewer.
cs.o: Expected benefits (illustrative): less repetitive data entry and clearer hand-overs.

faq: Will AI make decisions without a person?
Not where a decision matters. We build approval and escalation steps in.
How accurate will it be?
Accuracy depends on the task and data. We test on realistic cases and monitor quality after launch.
How is our data handled?
We agree what data is used, where it is processed and who has access before building.
Can it work with our existing tools?
Usually, through APIs and integrations. We check feasibility first.
Is AI right for every process?
No. We tell you when automation is not worthwhile.
ai-workflow-automation.note: We do not promise guaranteed results or fully autonomous decision-making. Where a decision matters, a person reviews it.

merchant-account-management.title: Merchant Account Management
merchant-account-management.short: Operational support for merchant accounts and payment workflows, alongside your payment provider.
merchant-account-management.lead: Hands-on support for onboarding, payment workflows and reporting, working alongside your licensed payment provider.
intro: We support businesses with the practical side of taking card and online payments: preparing onboarding information, coordinating with providers, connecting gateways to websites and keeping payment operations organised.
We are not a bank, payment processor or licensed financial institution. Approval, underwriting, settlement and compliance decisions always rest with your provider.
ch: Confusing onboarding
Applications ask for detailed documents and answers.
Integration gaps
Checkout flows and gateways need careful setup and testing.
Hard-to-read reporting
Transaction data is spread across dashboards and files.
Disputes and failed payments
Chargebacks and failures need clear processes and follow-up.
ap: Understand your business model and payment needs.
Organise the documents and information your provider requests.
Support communication with your chosen provider.
Connect gateways and checkout flows, then test them.
Review failures, disputes and workflows regularly.
sol: Connect gateways to your site or checkout.
Align checkout, orders and payment steps.
Match payments to orders and payouts.
Set up processes and organise evidence.
Find patterns behind declined or failed payments.
Work with your provider’s tools and rules.
Help with everyday questions and changes.
ben: A clearer view of payment activity
uc: UK online shop
Preparing onboarding information and connecting a gateway to checkout.
US subscription business
Organised monitoring of failed payments and follow-up processes.
Service business
Monthly payment reports and reconciliation support.

cs.p: A fictional online shop struggles to prepare its application and to track failed payments.
cs.s: An onboarding checklist, a tested gateway integration and a simple monthly payment report.
cs.o: Expected benefits (illustrative): fewer application delays and clearer payment reporting.

faq: Can you guarantee approval?
No. Approval is decided by the provider. We help you prepare a complete, accurate application.
Do you process payments?
No. Payments are processed by your chosen provider.
Are you a licensed financial institution?
No. We provide operational and integration support only.
Can you connect payments to our website?
Yes, as part of integration work.
Can you help with chargebacks?
We can help you set up processes and organise evidence. Outcomes are decided by the card networks and your provider.
merchant-account-management.note: This is operational support, not a regulated financial service. We cannot guarantee merchant account approval, rates or acceptance.

digital-marketing.title: Digital Marketing
digital-marketing.short: Search, content and campaigns built around measurable goals.
digital-marketing.lead: Marketing planned around clear goals, delivered consistently and reported honestly.
intro: We help businesses become easier to find and easier to choose: improving search visibility, creating useful content, running campaigns and measuring what works.
We plan for your audience in the UK, the US or both, and report in plain language so you can see what is happening and why.
ch: Hard to find online
Customers cannot find you for the searches that matter.
Unclear what works
Spend and effort are not tied to enquiries.
Weak landing pages
Visitors arrive but do not take the next step.
Inconsistent content
Posting is irregular and lacks a clear strategy.
ap: Review your website, content, search presence and current activity.
Set objectives, audiences, priorities and measures.
Carry out SEO, content, campaigns and page improvements.
Track the metrics agreed at the start.
Test, learn and refine each month.
sol: Improve how your site appears in search.
Fix crawling, speed and structure issues.
Plan useful content around customer questions.
Set up, monitor and refine paid campaigns.
Test changes that help visitors act.
Plain-language reports on what is working.
Visibility for local and overseas audiences.
Strategy for UK and US audiences
Messaging and tracking for each market.
ben: Clearer insight into what drives enquiries
Pages that guide visitors to act
uc: UK local-service business
Local SEO and a clearer service-page structure.
US online retailer
Product-page optimisation and paid campaign management.
Business serving both markets
Separate messaging and tracking for UK and US audiences.

cs.p: A fictional local business relies on word of mouth and wants steadier online enquiries.
cs.s: A technical SEO review, content built around customer questions and improvements to key pages, with a simple measurement framework.
cs.o: Measurement framework: track enquiries, organic visits and page-level conversion monthly. No results are claimed.

faq: How soon will we see results?
SEO and content take time. We agree realistic expectations and measures at the start.
Do you guarantee first-page rankings?
No. Nobody can honestly guarantee that.
Can you manage paid ads?
Yes, including setup, monitoring and reporting.
Do you work with our existing website?
Yes, and we can improve it where it limits results.
How do you report?
Plain-language monthly reports covering activity, performance and next steps.
digital-marketing.note: We do not guarantee rankings, traffic or sales. Results depend on your market, competition, budget and timing.

PR.description: Rehas.in is a digital wellness and spiritual platform bringing together ancient wisdom and modern wellness practices. Its services include holistic healing, meditation, astrology, horoscope readings, and spiritual guidance. The website presents these services and personalized wellness experiences in an accessible digital format. Grace Technologies contributed to the web development of the platform, helping organize its content and digital experiences into a professional website for people exploring traditional practices and wellness.
PR.o: A professional digital presence for Rehas.in's wellness and spiritual services.
